name: Kipfel
description: Kipfel 原生形态键（eye_close_left、eye_jitome_left、mouth_smile2_left、eyebrow_angry_left 等，左右后缀是 _left / _right）。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Kipfel's native shape keys (eye_close_left, eye_jitome_left, mouth_smile2_left, eyebrow_angry_left, ...; the side suffixes are _left / _right). Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: eyebrow_up_left
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 18.5mm（kipfel）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 18.5 mm (kipfel). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_up_right
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 18.5mm（kipfel）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 18.5 mm (kipfel). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_down_left
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 12.1mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 12.1 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_down_right
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 12.1mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 12.1 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_trouble_left
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 5.9mm（kipfel）。eyebrow_trouble：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 5.9 mm (kipfel). eyebrow_trouble: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_trouble_right
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 5.9mm（kipfel）。eyebrow_trouble：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 5.9 mm (kipfel). eyebrow_trouble: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_angry_left
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 9.7mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 9.7 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_angry_right
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 9.7mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 9.7 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_close_left

channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 28.2 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_close_right
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 28.2mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 28.2 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_jitome_left
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 5.2mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 5.2 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: eye_jitome_right

channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 5.2 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: eye_open_left

channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 4.9 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: eye_open_right
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 4.9mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 4.9 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: eye_under_up_left
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 9.1mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 9.1 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_under_up_right
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 9.1mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 9.1 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: option_pout_left
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（左侧）。最大位移 7.6mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (left). Max displacement 7.6 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: option_pout_right
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（右侧）。最大位移 7.6mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (right). Max displacement 7.6 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_a
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 6.0mm（kipfel）。a 口型张嘴幅度不大。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 6.0 mm (kipfel). "a" shape, the mouth does not open far. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_u
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 4.8mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 4.8 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_smile2_left

channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 2.6 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_smile2_right
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 2.6mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (right). Max displacement 2.6 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_sad_left
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（左侧）。最大位移 1.3mm（kipfel）。形变很小（嘴角下移约 0.2mm）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (left). Max displacement 1.3 mm (kipfel). Very small deformation (mouth corner down by about 0.2 mm). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_sad_right
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（右侧）。最大位移 1.3mm（kipfel）。形变很小（嘴角下移约 0.2mm）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (right). Max displacement 1.3 mm (kipfel). Very small deformation (mouth corner down by about 0.2 mm). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_wide_left
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（左侧）。最大位移 7.2mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (left). Max displacement 7.2 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_wide_right
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（右侧）。最大位移 7.2mm（kipfel）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (right). Max displacement 7.2 mm (kipfel). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_narrow_left
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（左侧）。最大位移 3.3mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (left). Max displacement 3.3 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_narrow_right
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（右侧）。最大位移 3.3mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (right). Max displacement 3.3 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_position_left
channels.note: 嘴整体移向角色左侧。最大位移 7.6mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth to the character's left. Max displacement 7.6 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_position_right
channels.note: 嘴整体移向角色右侧。最大位移 7.2mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth to the character's right. Max displacement 7.2 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_position_up
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 4.6mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 4.6 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: mouth_position_down
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 6.6mm（kipfel）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 6.6 mm (kipfel)

channels.name: eye_up
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 8.2mm（kipfel）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 8.2 mm (kipfel). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_down
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 9.0mm（kipfel）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 9.0 mm (kipfel). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_left
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 3.7mm（kipfel）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 3.7 mm (kipfel). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_right
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 3.9mm（kipfel）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 3.9 mm (kipfel). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
